gaps: ATTENTION RETURN: no measured span (results/analytic_bound_attn_unmeasured.json); the compiled span 148 is used

IMAGE CAPACITY: the full layer needs 13942 PW words (calendar 854 + tables 12608 = (PROG 72 + BTAB 188 + CROM 528) x 16) > CMD_CEIL 976: tt_ctlm cannot hold one layer's slice tables + calendar; and CROM post-scales / norm gains differ per layer (36 x) -> a per-layer table stream (ROM-resident slice tables or a table DMA) is needed

COLUMN-HEAD x CONSUMER: the qkv / gu / down / o matvecs read x from the slice x stream; the hr / xpf control that makes the column heads tap those words on the compiled edges is not lowered (QLB-C4b/3a left)
TILE DELIVERY: tile_first 40 (ME issue -> first far cluster word) and the AR stagger (slice s gets block b at M0 + 8 b + j - 26 - 2 s) are a contract no tool compiles into the ME / xhead calendar
PER-TOKEN RoPE ROW: cos / sin of the position must reach CROM ROPE every token; TLOAD plays static image blocks only (no producer of the per-token row on the die)
AR TAG CONTRACT (dv_lower_mat RTL gap): io_collective needs tag == cmd tag on every word and last only on the message last word; slice2 sends tag = row address, last per STN op (fault_code[2])
